meta.note: Toei stations + ridership are real (odpt:Station / odpt:passengerSurvey). JR/Metro stations (lineIds for the 14 non-Toei lines) are from OpenStreetMap (no ODPT coverage) -- their ridership is null (not invented) and ridershipBand is a FALLBACK heuristic (3 = serves >=2 of our lines, else 2), not measured data. inFloodZone for all stations is a low-lying-ward heuristic (Adachi, Arakawa, Edogawa, Katsushika, Koto, Sumida), not a flood-map lookup.
